entries.3cf734eb49f661aa: Under a three-year plan starting in fiscal 2025, it has set as its basic policy 'to aim to be a company that wins against competitors and achieves steady growth,' and says it will strengthen competitiveness in quality, cost, delivery and after-sales service to expand earnings. It lists the following as issues: developing new valves and actuators and strengthening sales of electronic actuators; promoting sales in overseas markets; reducing the cost of jacks and considering function-specific jacks; opening up customers for large, high-precision gears; and expanding orders as prime contractor for power plants in the construction business.

entries.9fdebd992c6a472e: Built on gear manufacturing technology since its founding in 1938, it has long manufactured and sold the valve actuator 'Limitorque' with technical assistance from a U.S. company, and it has also passed nuclear-related verification tests. Because its construction business handles maintenance of the equipment it sells, transactions with customers continue after the equipment is sold.
entries.aab0a57ff4fae1a3: It was founded in 1938 as Haruyama Automobile Industry Co., Ltd., and changed its name to its current name, NIPPON GEAR CO., LTD., in 1954. Its head office is in Nishi-Shinbashi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and its production base is the Fujisawa Plant in Fujisawa, Kanagawa Prefecture. As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 245, and it does not prepare consolidated financial statements.
